title: MakeABet
tagline: Full-stack scaffold for building prediction markets with PYUSD, Pyth Network & Hardhat 3
description: MakeABet is a production-ready, full-stack development scaffold that empowers developers to rapidly build decentralized prediction market applications. By integrating PYUSD stablecoin, Pyth Network's real-time price oracles, and Hardhat 3's advanced smart contract development tools, MakeABet provides everything needed to launch a prediction market platform in minutes.
how_its_made:
MakeABet enables users to:

Create prediction markets based on real-time cryptocurrency prices from Pyth Network
Place bets using PYUSD stablecoin on whether prices will go up or down
Track positions with a comprehensive dashboard showing active bets and potential returns
Settle markets automatically using Pyth's decentralized price feeds as the source of truth
Key Features
For Developers:

🚀 One-command setup - npx create-makeabet gets you started instantly
🔧 Complete monorepo - Frontend (React 19), Backend (Fastify), Smart Contracts (Hardhat 3)
🎨 Modern UI - Built with Mantine UI, fully responsive and accessible
🔗 Multi-wallet support - RainbowKit integration for seamless wallet connections
🧪 Built-in testing - Local faucet, mock data, and comprehensive test suite
☁️ One-click deployment - Railway-ready configuration included
For Users:

💰 PYUSD-powered betting - Stable, reliable transactions using PayPal's stablecoin
📊 Real-time price data - Pyth Network ensures accurate, tamper-proof price feeds
🎮 Demo & Live modes - Test with mock data or use real smart contracts
📱 Mobile-friendly - Works seamlessly across all devices
🌐 Multi-language - i18n support for global accessibility
